subject: Re: Production errors and tail latency — post-incident closure and commitments
messages:
From: Mike Chang <mike.chang@claritylabs.com>

Cc: Lisa Ren <lisa.ren@claritylabs.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 09:12:34 -0700
Subject: Production errors + tail latency since 06:30 PDT

Sofia —

We started seeing a spike of 5xx errors and 200–600ms tail latency on inference calls to model 'redwood-llama-7b-vq' beginning ~06:30 PDT this morning. Error rate peaked at ~4.2% (see attached graphs), and a few customer-facing flows timed out. I've attached an error sample and the latency graph (error-sample.log; graphs-06-24.png).

Can you confirm you've got an incident and an ETA for mitigation? This is impacting a live campaign. If helpful, we're happy to provide additional traces or a sample API key for reproducing.

Thanks,
Mike
Mike Chang
Senior SRE, Clarity Labs

Subject: Re: Production errors + tail latency since 06:30 PDT

Hi Mike —

Thanks for the rapid heads-up and the attachments. We've opened an incident (CLAR-1234) and I've looped in infra and our on-call. Initial triage request: could you confirm whether these requests are routed to Redwood Dedicated or Hosted tenancy, and share one full request/response trace (including request-id) so we can correlate with our logs?

Immediate next steps from our side:
- Kimberly & infra will pull slot allocation and batcher backlog logs.
- We'll draft a mutual action plan (MAP) for containment and a communication cadence.
- We'll provide a temporary mitigation recommendation (routing to smaller batch sizes and fallback model variant) within 60 minutes.

I've attached a MAP-draft.md with the proposed containment steps. We'll also include a link to a shared doc for postmortem collaboration.

Sincerely,
Sofia Ivanova
Head of Customer Reliability — Redwood Inference

(attachment: MAP-draft.md)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 11:30:05 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Production errors + tail latency — initial triage notes

Team — forwarding external report with quick triage notes. Key observations from the first hour: 
- Error pattern indicates transient OOM/rejects at the batcher boundary; quotas on certain GPU pools changed unexpectedly due to a scale decision churn earlier this morning.
- KV cache hit-rates remained stable; not a model weights issue.
- Batcher backlog spiked when a config deploying a smaller-quantized variant hit a new kernel path causing higher per-request compute time.

I pulled slot allocation logs and included them here (slot-alloc-logs.zip). Early mitigation applied: throttled burst autoscale and pinned traffic to the older quantized variant; that brought error rate down from 4.2% to ~0.7% within 25 minutes.

Action items (short):
- Kimberly: continue allocation rollbacks + follow up with infra on why autoscaler accepted the new config.
- Rishi: prepare an RCA draft and propose credits/SLR language if needed.
- Sofia: keep customer updates and run exec sync if they escalate.

-Kimberly
Engineering Manager, Serving Runtime

(attachment: slot-alloc-logs.zip)

For context: we were on Hosted tenancy with default routing to redwood-llama-7b-vq; traffic pattern was steady. We can provide additional traces for 06:28–06:45 if you need them.

-Mike

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Anna Hart <anna.hart@claritylabs.com>, Mike Chang <mike.chang@claritylabs.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 26 Jun 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Clarity Labs incident — RCA summary and remediation commitments

Anna and Mike —

Executive summary (TL;DR):
- Root cause: an automated config promotion triggered an experimental quantization kernel path for a model variant. This path increased per-request CPU/GPU kernel latency under certain sequence-length distributions, which in turn caused batcher queueing and transient OOM/rejects on the default Hosted pool.
- Containment: we rolled back the promotion and pinned traffic to the prior stable variant; error rate dropped to <1% within 30 minutes.
- Impact window: 2027-06-24T06:30:00–2027-06-24T07:10:00 PDT.

Remediation and timeline:
1) Short term (complete): rollback promotion; increase autoscaler guardrails to prevent accepting config promotions without canarying — completed 2027-06-24.
2) 1-week (in progress): add an automatic model-kernel compatibility check during config promotion; target complete 2027-07-01. Owner: Karthik Iyer.
3) 2-week (planned): implement a batcher backpressure metric and auto-shed noisy tenants to preserve SLOs; target complete 2027-07-10. Owner: Grace O'Connor.
4) Credits & contractual: propose a one-time service credit equal to 10% of June hosted spend for Clarity Labs; open to negotiation.

Attached: RCA-claritylabs-v1.pdf (technical write-up) and remediation-sprint-plan.xlsx (action tracker with owners/dates). We'll schedule an exec readout next week to walk the senior leadership through the timeline and preventive controls.

Please confirm the credits proposal and whether you want us to schedule the executive readout.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
VP, Customer Reliability — Redwood Inference

(attachments: RCA-claritylabs-v1.pdf; remediation-sprint-plan.xlsx)

- Immediate autoscaler guardrail added to prevent similar promotions without canarying (completed 2027-06-24).
- Credits proposal sent (attached) — pending your approval.

In-progress / upcoming items:

- Exec readout scheduled: 2027-07-06 10:00 PDT (calendar invite to follow).

Links: postmortem and action tracker are in the shared drive here: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1abcRCA-claritylabs-v1. Jira: CLAR-1234 for incident tracking.

Apologies again for the disruption — we're treating this as high priority and will send weekly status updates until all remediation items are complete.

Warmly,
Sofia Ivanova
